name: email-ses
title: Email with Amazon SES: your app sends sign-in links and invitations (needs AWS credentials)
description: `email.send` with Amazon SES v2: one email to one person, from the sender in EMAIL_FROM, each request signed with SigV4 over Web Crypto (no AWS SDK). Variables only, so both targets.

environment.name: AWS_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environment.description: The secret access key of an IAM user (or role) allowed `ses:SendEmail`. Read through secrets at start; only signatures made with it are sent.

environment.name: AWS_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environment.description: The access key id that goes with AWS_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (AKIA…).

environment.name: AWS_SES_SESSION_TOKEN
environment.description: The session token of temporary credentials (STS); leave it unset for an IAM user's key.

environment.name: AWS_SES_REGION
environment.description: The AWS region where the sender is verified in SES: us-east-1, eu-west-1…

environment.name: EMAIL_FROM
environment.description: The sender of every email: `bot@example.com` or `Assistant <bot@example.com>`, an address or domain verified in SES in that region.
